name: @osionos/ui
description: Shared React component kit: atoms, primitives, molecules and hooks, themed entirely through --osio-* custom properties so the host owns the palette. Ships no CSS of its own and no runtime dependencies — every library it uses is a peer.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:tokens

//devDependencies: The peers are duplicated here on purpose: `npm install` does not install OPTIONAL peer dependencies, so without these the standalone typecheck cannot resolve highlight.js/mermaid/react-virtual and CI fails on a package that is actually fine. Versions mirror the osionos host so the standalone check sees what the host sees.
